answer: Resist sybils with a prediction market on identity legitimacy: every identity carries a tradable future that pays out only if it survives N epochs without proven fraud, its price set by peers staking real money on its honesty. A fresh name starts umber-dark, near zero, and climbs only as the market, watching its work like a quill recording each deed, gains confidence. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand markets bought up against honest short-sellers, each fake's saffron-priced future bleeding capital to bettors who spot fraud, while an honest agent's price rises for free.
